question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate choice.

His students from his time at Manchester University remember his lectures as extraordinarily _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e.** 'lucid'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here the sentence wants to say that his students from his time at Manchester University remember his lectures as extraordinarily **easy to understand.**
 
• So, the word that can fill in the blank should have a meaning similar to** 'easy to understand'.**
 
• **Lucid** means* expressed clearly or easy to understand. *(स्पष्ट अर्थ का)
 
 
• **For Example **- Please write in a clear and** lucid** style.
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is** lucid**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: '**lucid'**.

**The correct sentence is**: His students from his time at Manchester University remember his lectures as extraordinarily **lucid__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the meaning of the other words given:
 
 
• **Ballistic** means moving under the force of gravity only. (केवल गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल के तहत गतिमान)

 
 
• **For Example** - Using the science of **ballistics**, I created a Frisbee that spins back toward the thrower.
 
 
 
• **Flaccid** means of part of the body) soft and hanging loosely or limply, especially so as to look or feel unpleasant. (झूलता हुआ)
 
 
• **For Example** - Shortly after death all the muscles in the body become soft and **flaccid**.
 
 
 
• **Rancid** means (foods containing fat or oil) smelling or tasting unpleasant as a result of being old and stale. (बासी)
 
 
• **For Example** - There was a bottle of **rancid** milk on the windowsill.
